def create_cms_index_pages(placeholder_slot="content"):
    """
    create cms home page and fill >content< placeholder with TextPlugin
    """
    from cms.api import add_plugin, create_page
    from cms.models import CMSPlugin
    from cms.plugin_pool import plugin_pool
    from cms.utils.placeholder import get_placeholder_conf
    from cms.utils.moderator import auto_moderate_page
    from cms.utils.urlutils import add_url_parameters

    page_data = {
        "title": "Home",
        "slug": "/",
        "language": "en",
        "template": "cms/pages/home.html",
    }

    home_page = create_page(**page_data)
    home_page.publish("en")

    home_page_conf = get_placeholder_conf("content")
    plugin_pool.get_text_plugin(home_page_conf["plugins"][0]).__name__
    text_plugin = add_plugin(
        placeholder=placeholder_slot,
        placeholder_slot=placeholder_slot,
        plugin_type=home_page_conf["plugins"][0],
        language="en",
        target=home_page,
        target_language="en",
        target_placeholder=placeholder_slot,
    )
    text_plugin.set_base_attr(
        "en",
        text="Home Page",
    )
    text_plugin.save()

    auto_moderate_page(home_page, None)

    return home_page
